rejected.reason: The group's summary asserts that '宝玉偶遇农庄村女与秦钟萌生情愫' (Baoyu met a village girl and developed feelings with Qin Zhong / Baoyu and Qin Zhong developed feelings with the village girl), which distorts the source occurrences n-15-2 and n-15-3 where Baoyu encountered Er Yatou at the village while Qin Zhong's mutual attraction was with the novice nun Zhineng'er at Shuiyue (Mantou) Nunnery, not with the farm girl.
